title: Rényi and Tsallis entropy monotonicity for Bernoulli sums
summary: Lean formalization of coordinatewise Rényi and Tsallis entropy monotonicity for finite independent Bernoulli sums on the closed half cube, for every real order in [0,2], as stated in Hillion-Johnson Conjecture 4.4. The complete core proves both entropy comparisons and the finite inverse-score association inequality. Concrete coefficient-law and entropy definitions are checked separately. VERIFICATION.md defines exact-source Linux acceptance and distinguishes historical association-only checkpoints.
